baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُجَادِلُ فِي اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَابٍ مُنِيرٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: The adversarial back-and-forth is deprived of three nonredundant checks: disclosed apprehension, route-giving direction, and written testimony that emits light. The repeated negation leaves the speech unsupported at the levels of cognition, orientation, and record.

activation_trace.role: Wrapped verbal contention supplies the adversarial motion being diagnosed.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the first missing cognitive check.
Gentle direction to road and truth supplies the second missing orienting check.
Ordered letters and the written artifact supply the absent documentary check.
Radiance makes the missing book disclosive rather than merely extant.

changed_reading.before: A person argues about God while ignorant.
changed_reading.after: The ayah diagnoses a dispute operating without any of three distinct correctives: apprehended truth, a route toward it, and an inspectable record that makes it visible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The tightly formed يُجَادِلُ stands beside the absent علم, هدى, and كتاب منير.
baseline_models.mechanism: A dispute can be tightly braided and internally coherent while lacking an external mark, a leading direction, and a beacon. The focus therefore distinguishes argumentative construction from warranted orientation; verbal tightness can counterfeit evidential strength.

activation_trace.role: Tight twisting supplies the image of an argument whose strands hold together.
A distinguishing mark supplies the absent external checkpoint.
A leader or foremost element supplies the absent directional front.
Joining one thing to another supplies a rival form of coherence that a true record would discipline.
A visible waymark or beacon supplies the absent public orientation.

changed_reading.before: The uninformed argument is loose or poorly assembled.
changed_reading.after: The argument may be impressively tight; its defect is that internal coherence has been mistaken for a marked, led, and illuminated route to truth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The social subject مِنَ النَّاسِ uses يُجَادِلُ about the object of worship.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dispute branch that throws a person onto hard ground activates a contest model: God-talk has become a social technique for putting an opponent down. The three absent warrants cease to be resources for discovery because the operative goal is positional defeat.

activation_trace.role: Human appearance in a social class supplies the arena in which the contest is staged.
Throwing a person down supplies defeat, rather than inquiry, as the dispute's functional aim.
Worship and the worshipped supply the high-stakes object converted into contest material.

changed_reading.before: The person exchanges claims about God without evidence.
changed_reading.after: The person turns discourse about worship into an opponent-toppling practice, so evidence, direction, and illumination are structurally irrelevant to the chosen aim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-duplicate in 22:3 adds that the unsupported disputant follows every rebel stripped of good; 22:4 then joins alliance to a written consequence, misdirection, and direction toward punishment. The missing guidance in 22:8 is therefore not an empty space but a position occupied by a counter-guide and a substitute chain of allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Verbal contention anchors the context sequence back to the focus act.
Following behind supplies the dependency hidden beneath apparently autonomous argument.
The overreaching rebel supplies the alternative leader being followed.
Being stripped of good until insolent specifies the counter-guide's operating quality.
A binding written determination supplies consequence even where an illuminating book is absent.
Loyal attachment supplies the relational bond that converts following into allegiance.
Departure from guidance and intended direction supplies the first outcome of that allegiance.
A directed course supplies the grim anti-guidance that fills the apparent vacuum.

structural_cues: 22:3 repeats the focus clause through بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ before adding the following relation.
22:4 immediately sequences written consequence, alliance, misdirection, and direction to punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical echo and the following-alliance-direction sequence; I infer that absent warranted guidance permits a counter-guide to occupy its role; a live alternative is that the verses merely juxtapose traits without making substitution causal.

changed_reading.after: The disputant is already being guided in reverse: unsupported argument presents itself as independent reasoning while relaying an allegiance-driven counter-direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate continuation gives the disputant a body that folds and turns its side away, with the stated purpose of misdirecting from an extended path. This turns the focus's tightly twisted جدل into an embodied rhetoric: the speech coils because the speaker's orientation is bent, and its social output is to bend others off route.

activation_trace.role: Tight twisting supplies the verbal geometry that the next ayah embodies.
Direction and course supply the orienting dimension negated in the focus.
Folding, bending, and turning supply the speaker's bodily torsion.
Turning the side in aversion gives that torsion a resistant posture.
Departure from intended direction supplies the effect imposed on others.
An extended traversable road supplies the route from which the rhetoric diverts.

structural_cues: 22:9 directly follows the focus with a participial bodily description.
The purpose construction لِيُضِلَّ links the turned posture to diversion from the path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate sequence, bodily turning, and a purpose of misdirection; I align that torsion with the tight-twist branch of جدل; a live alternative is that the posture marks pride while leaving the speech's internal mechanics unspecified.

changed_reading.before: The speaker lacks correct direction while arguing.
changed_reading.after: The argument is a directional technology: inward aversion becomes tightly turned speech that actively rotates hearers away from a traversable path.

context_deltas.mechanism: Travel through the earth is supposed to produce hearts that restrain ignorance, while blindness is relocated from eyes to hearts. Later, knowledge of truth passes into trust, a heart lowered like tranquil ground, and guidance onto a straight path. علم, هدى, and illuminating disclosure in the focus are thus stages of an embodied epistemic process rather than three synonyms for information.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower anchors the cognitive stage of the process.
Gentle direction anchors the process's movement from recognition into route.
Illumination anchors the visibility required for recognition.
Going and traversing supply encounter with evidence as the process's input.
The heart supplies the inner organ in which encountered evidence must become discernment.
Reason as a restraint against ignorance supplies disciplined uptake rather than data accumulation.
Blindness of heart supplies the failure mode despite intact outward sight.
Recognized knowledge supplies the explicit transition from disclosure to response.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies what knowledge recognizes.
Low tranquil ground supplies the heart's receptive settling after recognition.
Gentle direction supplies the onward movement that knowledge alone does not complete.
The straight road supplies the concrete orientation produced by guidance.
Uprightness and balanced straightness specify the path's stable form.

structural_cues: 22:46 explicitly contrasts intact eyes with blind hearts after commanding travel through the earth.
22:54 sequences knowing truth, trusting it, the heart's lowering, and guidance to a straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the bodily organs and the ordered response sequence; I infer a process linking encounter, restraint, recognition, receptivity, and direction; a live alternative is that these are parallel virtues rather than stages in one epistemic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The disputant lacks three kinds of evidence.
changed_reading.after: The disputant has failed an entire truth-forming process: outward encounter has not become inward restraint, recognized reality, receptive settling, or straight movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recitation sequence in 22:52 permits alien material to be cast into transmission, then removes it and makes the signs firm. Against that sequence, an illuminating book is not just stored content; it is a stabilized disclosure able to distinguish intrusive casting from a confirmed sign. The focus disputant lacks this correction-and-confirmation discipline.

activation_trace.role: The written artifact anchors the transmission whose integrity is at issue.
Illumination anchors the record's capacity to expose rather than conceal intrusion.
Recitation placed in sequence supplies the transmission channel.
Casting something down supplies the intrusive insertion and its repeated identification.
The overreaching rebel supplies the agent of contaminating insertion.
Removal followed by replacement supplies the correction stage.
Firm exactness supplies the confirmation and stabilization stage.
A manifest sign supplies the unit made firm and publicly recognizable.
Knowledge of what is disclosed supplies oversight of the correction process.

structural_cues: 22:52 repeats the casting agent and the cast material before sequencing removal and confirmation.
The corrected objects are the signs, linking textual transmission to manifest evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, insertion, removal, and firming; I infer that كتاب منير names a disclosure with analogous integrity controls; a live alternative is that 22:52 concerns prophetic recitation specifically and should not be generalized into a textual method.

changed_reading.before: The disputant lacks a scripture that could provide evidence.
changed_reading.after: The disputant lacks a stabilized and self-disclosing record by which borrowed, intrusive, or merely cast material can be separated from a confirmed sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late sequence supplies a protocol for not being captured by contention: continue the call from straight guidance, answer renewed dispute with a bounded statement of superior knowledge, defer final separation to judgment, and refer the whole matter to a comprehensive book. The focus person's lack is therefore procedural as well as evidential; the dispute has no principled stopping rule.

activation_trace.role: Revisiting speech and contest anchors the later response protocol to the focus behavior.
Mutual pulling between sides supplies contention as an attempt to capture the addressee.
Calling by speech supplies the positive action that continues without entering the pull.
Direction to truth supplies the caller's maintained orientation.
Balanced straightness supplies the route's resistance to lateral pulling.
The exact return of verbal contention supplies the test case for the protocol.
A concise utterance supplies the bounded response rather than an endless counter-braid.
Knowledge disclosed to the knower supplies the authority to which the bounded answer refers.
Judgment between parties supplies final separation outside the disputants' contest.
Comprehensive knowing supplies the scope that no human dispute can reproduce.
The written record supplies a comprehensive reference beyond improvised claims.
Ease after difficulty supplies the non-anxious closure made possible by that knowledge and record.

structural_cues: 22:67-70 forms an uninterrupted sequence from attempted contention to call, bounded answer, judgment, knowledge, and book.
22:68 repeats the focus root جدل, while 22:70 repeats both علم and كتاب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the direct lexical returns and ordered instructions; I infer that they constitute a stopping protocol contrasting with 22:8; a live alternative is that the sequence governs one ritual dispute without diagnosing disputation in general.

changed_reading.before: The focus dispute lacks enough evidence to reach the right conclusion.
changed_reading.after: The focus dispute also lacks governance: no straight stance, bounded answer, deferred judge, or authoritative record tells it when and how to stop.

context_deltas.mechanism: 22:71 nearly restates the focus's God-centered lack as worship without descended compelling warrant and without knowledge. The next ayah presents clear recited signs yet a visibly hostile response that nearly becomes assault. The focus's repeated 'without' can therefore name refusal or bypass of available warrant, not only innocent non-possession.

activation_trace.role: Worship and the worshipped anchor the evidential failure to God-directed commitment.
Disclosure to a knower anchors the warrant explicitly missing in both passages.
The written artifact anchors the kind of transmissible warrant the clear recitation can supply.
Submissive worship supplies the commitment being made without warrant.
Delivery from above supplies the absent authorization's source and direction.
Compelling proof supplies the explicit warrant not sent for the worship.
Disclosed knowledge supplies the second explicit warrant denied to the worshippers.
Following in vocal succession supplies the public presentation of the signs.
Manifest signs supply evidence that is present rather than unavailable.
Manifest appearance supplies the signs' clarity.
Recognition by a visible mark supplies the legibility of the hostile response.
Approaching an act supplies the transition from evidential refusal toward force.

structural_cues: 22:71 combines worship, no descended authority, and no knowledge in one construction.
22:72 moves from clear recited signs to a response whose faces are legible and whose violence is nearly enacted; the branchless س ط و occurrence supports the assault detail.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies absent warrants followed by present clear signs and near violence; I infer that some lack is maintained by refusal rather than circumstance; a live alternative is that 22:8 and 22:71 describe simple ignorance while 22:72 introduces a different group.

changed_reading.before: The disputant happens not to possess knowledge, guidance, or an illuminating book.
changed_reading.after: The disputant's 'without' may be an enacted bypass of warrant: commitment and contest continue precisely by refusing what could authorize, correct, or expose them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing diagnosis that they did not measure God with His true measure gives the focus's فِي اللَّهِ a scale problem. Speech has exceeded its measuring capacity: without knowledge, direction, or illuminating record, the argument cannot keep its claims proportioned to their object.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped object anchors the question of whether discourse is proportioned to God.
Disclosed knowledge supplies a missing constraint on the scale of claims.
The measure by which a thing reaches its limit supplies proportional judgment as the failed operation.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the standard the measure should match.

structural_cues: 22:74 repeats اللَّه twice and encloses the true measure between the two occurrences.
The diagnosis follows the unsupported worship and hostile reception sequence of 22:71-73.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a failed true measure after unsupported God-directed acts; I infer that the focus dispute is rhetorically over-scale; a live alternative is that 22:74 condemns worship alone rather than the proportions of speech.

changed_reading.before: The argument reaches an incorrect proposition about God.
changed_reading.after: The argument is unauthorized measurement: it speaks at a scale its absent knowledge, direction, and record cannot responsibly bound.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps epistemic nouns into an ecological cycle; it remains anchored because the focus inventories themselves include علم as gathered water and نور as blossom, while 22:5 and 22:63 supply water-to-growth sequences. Downstream prose should mark this as a material resonance, not claim that علم or منير lexically means vegetation here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus lacks علم and ends with a book characterized by منير.

activation_trace.role: A large gathered body of water supplies latent epistemic reserve.
Joining one thing to another supplies an organized bed in which growth could cohere.
Tree blossom supplies visible fruiting as the absent endpoint.
Water delivered by pouring supplies the activating input to dead ground.
Earth and plant stirring with life supply the first responsive motion.
Nourishment and growth supply expansion after activation.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies produced rather than merely agitated discourse.
Fresh beauty supplies the cycle's inspectable fruit.
A second delivered-water scene confirms the recurrent activating input.
Tender green growth supplies visible vitality as the recurrent outcome.

changed_reading.before: The dispute is active speech with too little information.
changed_reading.after: The dispute is sterile activity: it shakes verbally but has no reservoir, cultivated joining, or illumination capable of germinating into visible truth-bearing fruit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant sacrificial هدي branch beneath focus هدى; it remains valid as a resonance because that branch is in the focus inventory and the surah's rite sequence names sacrifice, offered camels, and what reaches God. Downstream prose should retain the ordinary guidance sense and present the offering sense only as a pilgrimage-charged undertone.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus says وَلَا هُدًى inside a surah whose ritual sequence repeatedly materializes approach and offering.

activation_trace.role: The offering carried to the sanctuary supplies a latent sense of costly approach.
Verbal contention supplies the disembodied practice contrasted with offering.
Sacrificial offering supplies the surah's explicit ritual mode of approach.
The offered camel supplies a costly body rather than a merely verbal claim.
A marked ritual sign supplies public embodiment of committed approach.
Reaching and attaining supply the question of what an offering actually delivers.
Placing oneself in protection supplies inward commitment as what reaches beyond flesh and blood.
Direction to truth reconnects the ritual resonance to the focus word's primary orienting force.

changed_reading.before: The disputant approaches God-talk without guidance.
changed_reading.after: The disputant also approaches with nothing offered: no costly embodied submission, protective commitment, or directed gift interrupts the self-sufficient verbal contest.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it places illumination and fire on two branches of the same ن و ر inventory; it remains anchored by focus منير and context نار after litigants and after near-assault against reciters. Downstream prose must frame this as a contrast between stable disclosure and destructive heat, never as a claim that منير means fire in 22:8.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The absent كِتَابٍ مُنِيرٍ joins a written carrier to the radiance branch of ن و ر.

activation_trace.role: The written carrier supplies a stable medium for illumination.
Radiance supplies disclosure as the focus's positive light pole.
Contention between opponents supplies the conflict setting adjacent to the first fire image.
Kindled fire supplies destructive luminosity after the two-party conflict.
Manifest signs supply disclosure presented before the hostile reaction.
Approaching violent action supplies the conversion of resisted disclosure into heat.
Kindled fire supplies the destructive pole named after the near-assault sequence.

changed_reading.before: An illuminating book would add more light to the debate.
changed_reading.after: An illuminating book would discriminate light from heat: without a stable written carrier, the intensity generated by conflict can masquerade as disclosure while tending toward combustion.

strongest_changes: 22:3-4 turns absent guidance into active counter-guidance through following, allegiance, misdirection, and a binding consequence.
22:9 gives disputation a bodily geometry in which turned posture becomes tightly turned speech that diverts others.
22:46 and 22:54 turn knowledge, illumination, and guidance into an embodied process from encounter through heart-level discernment to straight movement.
22:67-70 supplies the missing procedural controls: a straight stance, bounded answer, deferred judgment, and comprehensive record.
22:71-72 makes it possible to read 'without' as refusal of available warrant rather than innocent lack alone.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed both direct lexical recurrences and material domains that a local reading would miss: the opening counter-guide returns as a late dispute protocol, while pilgrimage offering, rain-growth, and light-fire contrasts activate contained secondary readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The counter-guidance and turned-body readings depend on taking 22:3-4 and 22:9 as deliberate expansions of the focus's disputant.
The correction mechanism in 22:52 may belong specifically to prophetic recitation rather than to every illuminating book.
The scope of كتاب remains live between revealed textual witness and the comprehensive register in 22:70.
The ecological, sacrificial, and light-fire models are packet-anchored resonances, not replacements for the ordinary lexical reading.
